skill.name: design-orchestration
skill.description: Orchestrates design workflows by routing work through brainstorming, multi-agent review, and execution readiness in the correct order.
skill.summary: Routes design work through brainstorming, risk assessment, review, and execution readiness checks.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Unreviewed designs can create avoidable implementation risks and costly rework. This skill routes design work through brainstorming, risk assessment, validation, and readiness checks.
actual_capabilities: Determines whether a validated design exists before implementation planning begins.
Classifies design risk as low, moderate, or high using impact, complexity, uncertainty, novelty, and operational factors.
Routes low-risk work to planning and escalates moderate-risk or high-risk work for additional review.
Checks for an Understanding Lock, current design, and Decision Log before multi-agent review.
Blocks implementation when approval, assumptions, risks, or required design artifacts are incomplete.
limitations: The skill coordinates workflow but does not generate designs.
It depends on separate brainstorming, review, planning, or implementation skills.
Risk classification is qualitative and does not use a numerical scoring model.
It does not replace testing, environment validation, or expert review.

use_cases.title: Route a New Product Feature
use_cases.description: Assess a proposed feature, require design artifacts, and identify the next review or planning step.

use_cases.title: Review a System Change
use_cases.description: Classify architectural risk and require multi-agent validation when operational impact or uncertainty is high.

use_cases.title: Check Implementation Readiness
use_cases.description: Verify approval, assumptions, risks, and decision records before engineering work begins.

prompt_templates.title: Route a Feature Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Route this feature request through the design workflow. Identify required artifacts and the next skill to run: [feature request].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a new feature has not entered design review.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Design Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this design as low, moderate, or high risk. Explain the factors and select the required next step: [design].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after an initial design and Decision Log exist.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Review Inputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this design package is ready for multi-agent review. Report missing artifacts and restrict the review scope: [design package].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before escalating a moderate-risk or high-risk design.

prompt_templates.title: Decide Execution Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this reviewed design for implementation readiness. Route APPROVED, REVISE, or REJECT outcomes and state the next step: [review result].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after formal review to enforce the final workflow decision.

output_examples.input: A team proposes a small, reversible label change with a completed design and Decision Log.
output_examples.output: Risk: Low. The design is validated and reversible. Proceed to implementation planning.

output_examples.input: A team proposes a new payment flow with unresolved compliance assumptions.
output_examples.output: Risk: High. Run multi-agent-brainstorming after documenting compliance assumptions and completing the Decision Log.

output_examples.input: A reviewed architecture is marked REVISE because its rollback strategy is incomplete.
output_examples.output: Execution is blocked. Return the design for revision, resolve the rollback decision, and repeat review.

best_practices: Provide the current design, Understanding Lock, and Decision Log before requesting orchestration.
Document why each risk factor changes the required review level.
State the final review disposition and next step explicitly.
anti_patterns: Do not begin implementation before design approval and readiness checks.
Do not use multi-agent review to reopen scope or add new ideas.
Do not silently skip, add, or reduce required review stages.

faq.question: Does this skill create the design?
faq.answer: No. It routes work between design generation, validation, and implementation planning skills.

faq.question: When is multi-agent review required?
faq.answer: It is required for high-risk designs and recommended for moderate-risk designs.

faq.question: What information supports risk classification?
faq.answer: The skill considers user impact, irreversibility, operational cost, complexity, uncertainty, and novelty.

faq.question: What artifacts are required for review?
faq.answer: Provide a completed Understanding Lock, the current design, and a Decision Log.

faq.question: Can review introduce new features or scope?
faq.answer: No. Multi-agent review is limited to critique, revision, and decision resolution.

faq.question: What happens when readiness checks fail?
faq.answer: Implementation is blocked, and the workflow returns to the appropriate design or review step.
